issues.legal_issue: A plaint cannot be rejected at the threshold as time-barred where its allegations, read as a whole, leave material questions about when the right to sue accrued or depend on disputed facts.
material_facts: An administrator of a will brought a suit seeking partition of the estate and related relief, including accounts and declarations concerning a tenancy and mortgage claims.

The plaint alleged that a written undertaking recorded that the defendant would not claim tenancy rights or a charge over the property and would render accounts concerning rental income and redeemed mortgages.
The plaintiff alleged that the parties’ dispute arose after the defendant acted contrary to the undertaking, and that the suit was filed following that dispute.
The defendant disputed the undertaking, and the High Court held some of the claims time-barred on the basis of the plaint.
issues.conclusion: The High Court erred in allowing the plaint to be rejected in part as time-barred. The Supreme Court set aside that decision and rejected the application for rejection of the plaint, leaving the suit to proceed without deciding limitation on its merits.
issues.legal_principle: Under Order VII Rule 11(d) of the Code of Civil Procedure, the plaint must be read in its entirety, without adding to or subtracting from it, to determine whether it shows that the suit is barred by law. As stated in Popat and Kotecha Property v. State Bank of India Staff Association, the bar must appear from the plaint itself. Where the limitation question depends on disputed facts or on when the right to sue accrued, it is a mixed question of fact and law and cannot be resolved on an application to reject the plaint. The parties’ arguments invoked Articles 58, 59 and 69 of the Limitation Act, 1963, but the Court did not finally determine the applicable limitation period or its merits.

rule.if: threshold_plaint_rejection_application and plaint_alleges_undertaking_before_dispute and defendant_disputes_undertaking and plaint_claims_connected_estate_relief

predicates.threshold_plaint_rejection_application: A defendant sought rejection of a plaint at the threshold on the ground that the suit was barred by law.
predicates.plaint_alleges_undertaking_before_disput: The plaintiff alleged that an undertaking addressed the disputed rights before a later dispute arose.
predicates.defendant_disputes_undertaking: The defendant disputed the undertaking on which the plaintiff relied.
predicates.plaint_claims_connected_estate_relief: The plaintiff sought partition of an estate together with related accounts or declarations.

issues.definition: When a threshold application seeks rejection of a plaint, and the plaint alleges an undertaking preceding a dispute in connected estate claims that the defendant contests, the application is rejected rather than the plaint being rejected at that stage.
